name: raise-escalation-threshold
description: Raise the churn-risk escalation threshold from $50,000 to $100,000 per year in the canonical escalation-criteria fragment. The declared graph only reaches escalation-writer; triage-router paraphrases the old threshold in its local routing-rules fragment and silently keeps routing on $50k — the sync agent must infer that edge and propose the fix.

inferenceMustFind.contradiction: routing-rules still says 'roughly $50k+ a year in orders'; canonical criteria now says $100,000 per year

demo.before: triage-router routes the $70k churn ticket to escalation (old $50k rule)
demo.after: once the inferred proposal for routing-rules is approved, triage-router routes the same ticket to order — $70k is below the new $100k threshold
